title: Three bright transients on 19 July 1952 found by Enrique Solano

tellings.quote: And then my colleague Enrique Solano in Spain, he discovered another such really beautiful example with three super bright beautiful stars. It's the most beautiful example of all we have. This one is from the 19th of July, 1952.

plain: On a photographic plate taken on 19 July 1952 for the Palomar Observatory Sky Survey, a 1950s photographic map of the night sky, three very bright points of light appear like stars that are not there on other pictures of the same spot, the kind of short flash that could mean unknown objects reflecting sunlight above the Earth. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells Michels her colleague Enrique Solano in Spain found it, calling it "the most beautiful example of all we have."
